[1/4] Plan: opt-in SelfModel forecast bridge into the calibration journal

impact_assessment.why: The persistent SelfModel records confidence/outcome pairs and the calibration journal can store them, but no logged run connects the two: real-run forecasts stay in memory and vanish on exit, so cross-run calibration needs hand-built records.
impact_assessment.benefits: run_task_logged(calibration_path=...) appends only the current run's forecasts after the verdict, under a header-digest prefix; a default T3:15 run stays 13 in-memory forecasts with no file, the logged run persists 13/13 with the same Brier 0.230769, and a second run appends only 6 new records (19 total, two prefixes).
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SelfModel forecast_count/forecasts and run_task_logged calibration_path; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: calibration_store lock; state: new local journal append after the verdict, opt-in.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fail fast without a persistent SelfModel/forecast API; capture the pre-run count and slice only that run; prefix ids with the header digest; test default/logged/two-runs/missing/corrupt/actions; rerun 314 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: non-destructive Merkle journal compaction into one union-root anchor with optional backed-up replace

impact_assessment.why: The .merkle.journal appends one anchor per batch and grows without bound. A compacted journal can keep one root over the union of all anchored ranges, preserving every record proof while bounding the journal to one line, with the original kept as .bak on opt-in replace.
impact_assessment.benefits: compact_merkle_journal writes a one-anchor compact journal, records source anchors/head in a .compaction sidecar, keeps the original untouched by default, and with replace=True backs the original up as .bak; proofs for first/middle/last records still verify, and verification names missing/truncated/invalid journals.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new merkle compaction function only, existing append/verify/proof APIs unchanged; dependency: stdlib shutil added; concurrency: offline single-writer rewrite (no live-append lock); state: new .compact/.compaction/.bak files, opt-in replace.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require a valid journal and log ranges; compute the union root from log digests; write atomically; keep the original by default; back it up before replace; test copy/replace/proofs/metadata/missing/truncated/same-output/invalid flags and no temp leftovers; rerun 314 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: pure rule-path confidence/uncertainty readout from BFS move ties

impact_assessment.why: The probe carries dead-pool/cycle facts but no statement of how ambiguous the rule action is. A pure readout of the number of equally best free moves gives per-step planning confidence without changing the action.
impact_assessment.benefits: probe.rule carries goal/distance/ties/confidence/rule_distance/optimal; unique moves score 1.0, two-way ties 0.5; rule_readout=False removes the field; actions/steps/rewards are identical; the readout is auditable in telemetry and can be aggregated across seeds.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner rule_readout keyword and policy key (digest changes); dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: no schema change; telemetry probe grows by one field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compute the readout only for a resolved goal; keep it pure and side-effect-free; compare on/off actions across unit states and pin seeds; test unique/tie/collect/off/no-goal/invalid/policy; rerun 322 tests and AIKit.
